analysis:
Docs-only change to docs/architecture/inference.md. The two head_text units cover lines 402-1209. The only changed lines in that range are 876-877 (the TemplateRenderCheck multimodal-fixture sentence, now gated by the 'shared media discovery policy') and line 729, a base-side edit. Both are prose and change no code or controls.

The main addition is head lines 25-171, a new section on the unregistered NemotronSuperLocalBridgeBuilder, NemotronSuperLocalBinding/Load/PromptContract, MTP opt-in, checkpoint bank and image binding. It is not in these units; only a truncated patch excerpt is visible. The next pass must review those lines against T-041, TB-007 and A-001. Claims to check: pretokenized text only, no media/tools/schemas/client prompt-cache keys, text prefix reuse only when the owner has a checkpoint bank, no model registration and no HTTP route.

Visible text in 402-1209 is consistent with the existing threat model on the points checked. For T-041 it keeps the SSD prefix cache encrypted, default-on, with per-donation gating and the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate, and adds no TTL, HMAC-name or scope changes. For media and decode, bounded ingress caps, in-memory video assets (no disk write, matching T-050) and typed refusals are described, and I saw no weakening. The doc states that deadline calibration and MTP typical acceptance are not qualification or security claims. Because the docs-only 25-171 content is unseen, I record this as a coverage gap, not a finding.
